Senses.Explanation: A fixed nickname for the sage, the yellow-faced Gautama, usually spent to fault or to toy with him. Beijian Jujian asks why, when the yellow-faced one netted all with the hard-to-believe way, five hundred monks left Vulture Peak with swept sleeves, and answers that giving no thing at all is easy to believe, the two ways ice and coal to each other, Wuzhun Shifan enters the buddha-hall and rules that with Kasyapa's raised fist and Ananda's palms the yellow-faced one has no tricks at all, Yanxi Guangwen strikes once with the whisk at the winter-eighth day and has the yellow-faced one's house scattered and lost, everyone on earth eyes level and nose straight, and Gaofeng Yuanmiao laughs at the midnight awakening as calling a slave a lord, his own telling no better than the sister-in-law's grudge. Feiyin Tongrong reads the newborn's first showing as the yellow-faced one's utmost baring of the original face, for sage and commoner, lost and awake, humans, heaven, and other kinds alike, Juelang Daosheng works the seated-woman story till the yellow-faced one stands revealed as toying with the crowd, a whole stage of puppets with strings to be found, Baiyu Jingsi has him born on the master's staff-tip, roaring sky-and-earth-alone-honored, then tells him to stop his showing off, leaving the yellow-faced one shamefaced with nowhere to hide, and Guxue Zhenzhe tells the assembly after the week's examination that even were the yellow-faced one to arrive, he would be told to carry straw sandals, like Deshan, Mazu, Huangbo, and Linji before him.
